text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
I-I am so terribly sorry. Due to an ordering error on our end,
our usual tea leaves haven't arrived, and our stock has run dry...
I sincerely apologize!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Making the King come in person and wasting our time.
Should such disrespect occur again—

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I-I'm so sorry! N-Never again...
I-I will formulate a proper plan for the future and report back, so please, have mercy, I beg of you~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Orfevre tried to enjoy some tea at an antique café for a change of pace, but it seems she didn't have a very good time...
